plugins.name: pptx-deck
plugins.description: Create polished PowerPoint (.pptx) presentations from plain text. Brand-agnostic — auto-detects colors from .potx templates or picks a palette. Includes 7 slide patterns: title, flow diagram, cards, metrics, timeline, summary.

skills.name: create-deck
skills.description: Creates a professional PowerPoint presentation (.pptx) from any content. Use when the user asks to make a deck, slides, presentation, or .pptx file. Accepts topic descriptions, markdown notes, bullet points, or structured data. Handles brand setup automatically.
headings: Prints a ready-to-paste BRAND config block
skills.description_zh: 根据主题、Markdown 笔记、要点或结构化数据创建专业 PowerPoint 文件，自动处理品牌设置，适用于演示文稿、幻灯片及 PPTX 制作。
